planets.name: TOI-470 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-470 with a 12.2-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-470 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-470. Its orbit and size follow Oddo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
